gelb-rote Karte.et: Literally, “yellow-red card”. The referee shows the player the yellow card, immediately followed by the red.

Gelbsucht.et: From Middle High German gelsucht, gelsuht, from Old High German gelasuht, gelosuht, gelewasuht. By surface analysis, gelb + Sucht.
